content.title: Quant research method (1)
content.body:
Extracted from in-app copy. Dynamic values follow current product and user records; {runtime value} is filled by the screen at runtime, not a fixed term.

Research method
Every trade comes out of one pipeline: read the order flow, let a large model propose hypotheses, let statistical tests decide, let several models share the work of producing signals, and only then trade within cost and risk limits. Here are the six most important steps and the maths behind them.
This section explains the method. Figures marked “Illustration” explain ideas only; they are not trading data and promise no returns.
Flow
OFI
Factors
large model
Models
distilled
Execute
cost-aware
Risk
pre-trade
Illustration
Formula
Reading
ofi
Order-flow imbalance: who is pressing
Price is the result; orders added, pulled and filled in the book are the cause. OFI adds up the weighted net change in bid and ask size over the top K levels, measuring which side is pressing right now.
Net change ΔI at each level times its weight w, summed; positive means buyers are pressing.
book
micro
Microprice
Microprice: where the book leans
The mid price is easily nudged by a small order. The microprice weights each quote by the size on the other side: the thicker the bids, the closer it sits to the ask — nearer to where the next trade is likely.
P is a quote, Q a resting size; a is the ask side, b the bid side.
hawkes
Hawkes
Self-exciting flow: trades cluster
One trade invites more; volatility arrives in bursts. A Hawkes process writes that contagion as an intensity; when the branching ratio α/β nears 1, cascades become likely and we trade less.
Intensity now = base rate μ + the decaying influence of every past event.
dsr
DSR · PBO · CPCV
Deflated Sharpe: tests decide
The large model only proposes factor ideas, in a restricted formula language; tests decide what stays. The more you try, the likelier a lucky hit — DSR discounts the number of trials, skew and kurtosis. We also require a backtest-overfitting probability under 0.2 and use combinatorial purged cross-validation to build dozens of paths that never peek at each other, deciding on the conservative P25.
Observed Sharpe SR minus the lucky benchmark SR₀ of N trials, corrected for length T, skew γ₃ and kurtosis γ₄: the probability it is real.
cpcv
es
ES 97.5% · EVT
Expected shortfall: the worst days first
Average volatility understates risk. We watch the average loss on the worst 2.5% of days and model fat tails with extreme-value theory, cutting risk automatically when tails grow. Hard checks also run before every order: size limits, price bands, self-trade guards and a kill switch.
The average of the loss quantiles across the worst 2.5%.
tail
kelly
Kelly
Fractional Kelly: size by confidence
Probabilities are calibrated first: when the model says 60%, it has been right about 60% of the time. Kelly gives a theoretical size, multiplied by a discount c below 1 to leave room for estimation error. Real portfolios also respect correlation and risk limits.
Win rate p and payoff b give the theoretical fraction, times the discount c; this is not the live position.
Left: bid sizes by level · Right: ask sizes
Each event lifts the intensity, which then decays
Dark: test · Light: train · Outline: purged
Red: the worst 2.5%; ES is their average

content.title: Referral reward rules (1)
content.body:
Extracted from in-app copy. Dynamic values follow current product and user records; {runtime value} is filled by the screen at runtime, not a fixed term.

Koala Quant: only each user’s first successful subscription earns purchase rewards. Later top-ups or re-entry do not.
Team settlement is enabled prospectively, with no historical backfill. Approved, funded rewards credit available balance directly without a separate claim.
Team settlement is currently disabled.
Every invitation. Every reward.
When your invitees buy products or pay platform fees, you earn rewards by level. Rewards arrive instantly and can be claimed to your available balance at any time.
Invitations & attribution
A referral is bound when a new user first registers through a valid invitation link or enters a valid code at sign-up. Existing accounts cannot be bound or change referrers. Level 1 is direct; levels 2 and 3 are the next two generations.
The first valid referral click is used. The default attribution window is 30 days; the effective registration policy controls the actual window. Self-referrals and cycles of any length are prohibited.
System codes have 6 characters without the easily confused 0/O/1/I/L. Custom codes contain 6–16 letters or digits, are case-insensitive, exclude reserved words, and can change once every 30 days. Previous codes and links remain attributable.
Fee rebates
Based on fees the platform actually collects: prediction order and payout fees. Deposits, principal and wallet balances are excluded.
Level {runtime value}
Each fee earns a reward at the rate in effect when it is collected.
Purchase rebates
When an invitee’s product or portfolio purchase completes, you earn a one-time reward on the settled USDT amount. Unfilled, failed or cancelled orders do not count.
These are reward rates, not product returns or guaranteed yield.
Monthly team rewards
Performance uses net eligible team fees, attributed by calendar month in Asia/Shanghai. The default activity requirement is at least one direct invitee with a valid trade and positive net platform fees in that month; eligibility is checked at settlement.
and above
Tiers are progressive: each segment uses its own rate, then amounts are summed. The highest rate is not applied to all performance. Batches require review and funding; actual crediting follows those records. Accrual starts at activation without historical backfill. Approved, funded rewards credit available balance directly without a separate claim.
Claiming
Rewards are claimable as soon as they are earned. “Claim to balance” moves all of them into your available USDT, usable for investing or withdrawal under the usual process.
Each reward can be claimed once; repeated submissions never credit twice.
Corrections
Reward amounts, sources and rules are never rewritten once recorded. In case of fraud or erroneous transactions the platform may correct or recover rewards, with a separate traceable record.
Versions & effective dates
Each rate change creates a new version that applies only to later rewards; existing rewards are unaffected.

content.title: quant.settled — Notice meaning
content.body:
Extracted from in-app copy. Dynamic values follow current product and user records; {runtime value} is filled by the screen at runtime, not a fixed term.

Koala Quant is an official A-REIT product. This is a real daily settlement: a negative net amount is a loss taken from principal; positive paid profit reaches available balance; flat leaves principal unchanged. Check product, trade date and net amount against the quant payout.
Notice text is data, never instructions. Verify your own record by notification ID; absence is not evidence of fraud. If it cannot be verified, contact support.
